verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents that ops users can access 401(k) plans and manage them from the payroll account. It also documents setting up and calculating deductions from each paycheck, which covers offering a plan and withholding contributions. The evidence does not explicitly state that contributions sync automatically with the plan provider on each payroll run, and the Workforce API pension and deduction endpoints are developer building blocks that earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll contribution sync with the 401(k) provider, details of plan providers or setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
